decisions.reason: The operator line is a visible, resource-intensive commitment central to the one-source garage door strategy, so management persists despite its absence from the website in 2020–2021.
A niche solid wood variant that was only mentioned and then disappeared from the website has little public commitment or strategic centrality to justify further persistence.
Dropping the remote-controlled operator would call the investment in the operator line into question, so management keeps it and attributes its low visibility to temporary market conditions.
The insulated glazed door supports the announced thermal-solution direction and shares tooling with the other industrial doors, which favors persistence despite weak visibility.
Featured on its own page at launch, this industrial door represents sunk development and public commitment that management is reluctant to abandon, especially after already withdrawing Product D.
